description: Single-panel fatigue-cycling plot: stress amplitude (MPa, linear axis 200-1100) versus number of cycles (log axis, 10^0 to 10^5). Two curve families are superimposed. The dotted curves are Fe-30Mn-9Al-1C [161] tested at a total strain amplitude of 0.8% after three aging treatments, each curve labelled "0.8": the "Aged 550 °C/24 h" curve lies highest (starting just above 1000 MPa and declining to about 750 MPa by ~10^4 cycles), "710 °C/2 h [161]" declines from ~750 to ~520 MPa, and "550 °C/2 h [161]" from ~690 to ~540 MPa — all monotonic cyclic softening. The solid curves are Fe-30Mn-10Al-0.4C [162] at total strain amplitudes 0.2, 0.4, 0.8, 1.0, 1.5 and 2.0, printed as numbers on the curves; the "Total strain amplitude 0.2" curve is almost flat near 320 MPa and the 0.4% curve near 425 MPa, whereas the 1.0, 1.5 and 2.0 curves show a short initial rise (peak near 660-690 MPa between ~10^1 and 10^2 cycles) followed by softening. The "0.8" label appears twice on solid curves, at different levels. Together the panel contrasts monotonic softening of the aged Fe-30Mn-9Al-1C with the amplitude-dependent strengthen-then-soften response of Fe-30Mn-10Al-0.4C.

observations.observation: The panel is a fatigue plot with stress amplitude (MPa) on a linear y-axis from 200 to 1100 and Number of cycles on a logarithmic x-axis from 10^0 to 10^5.

Three dotted curves are each labelled '0.8' and annotated 'Fe-30Mn-9Al-1C [161] Aged 550 °C/24 h', '710 °C/2 h [161]' and '550 °C/2 h [161]'; all decline monotonically with cycling, with the 550 °C/24 h curve highest and the 550 °C/2 h curve lowest.
The solid curves carry the printed labels 0.2, 0.4, 0.8, 1.0, 1.5 and 2.0, with the text 'Fe-30Mn-10Al-0.4C [162]' and 'Total strain amplitude 0.2' placed near the lowest, flattest curve.

The solid curve labelled 0.2 stays essentially flat near 300-320 MPa over 10^0 to 10^4 cycles, and the curve labelled 0.4 is nearly flat near 425 MPa, i.e. no cyclic softening or hardening is visible at the two lowest amplitudes.

The solid curves labelled 1.0, 1.5 and 2.0 rise over roughly the first 10-100 cycles and then decline, giving the strengthen-then-soften shape; the corresponding stress levels are read only against gridlines, as no data values are printed.

The label '0.8' appears twice on the solid-curve family at different stress levels (one near the start of the test at about 465 MPa, one near 2x10^2 cycles at about 530 MPa), so the assignment of these two labels to individual curves is ambiguous at the supplied resolution.
The caption states that the dotted curves are Fe-30Mn-9Al-1C after three aging treatments tested at a strain amplitude of 0.8%.
The caption states that the solid curves are Fe-30Mn-10Al-0.4C tested at strain amplitudes ranging from 0.2% to 2.0%.

The citing text states that the Fe-29.7Mn-8.7Al-1C alloy was solution treated at 1100 °C and aged at 550 °C for 2 h, 550 °C for 24 h, or 710 °C for 2 h, and that cyclic softening occurred for all three aging practices at 0.8% strain amplitude.
The citing text states that the specimen aged 24 h endured higher stress amplitudes, from 1000 MPa to 750 MPa, and softened cyclically.

The citing text attributes the cyclic softening of the aged alloy to planar slip, shearing of κ-carbides, mechanical dissolution of precipitates and formation of persistent slip bands, with precipitate-free zones proposed for the 710 °C aged specimen.

The citing text states that the Fe-30Mn-10Al-0.4C alloy had a duplex austenite (~65%) plus ferrite microstructure, that cyclic softening occurred below 0.6% strain amplitude, that strengthening preceded softening above 0.6%, and that fatigue cracks initiated in ferrite.
The citing text states that cyclic softening was not observed at strain amplitudes greater than 2.0%.

subfigures.description: Stress amplitude (MPa, 200-1100 linear) vs number of cycles (10^0-10^5, log) fatigue plot containing two curve families: dotted curves for Fe-30Mn-9Al-1C [161] after three agings at 0.8% strain amplitude (labelled Aged 550 °C/24 h, 710 °C/2 h, 550 °C/2 h), and solid curves for Fe-30Mn-10Al-0.4C [162] at total strain amplitudes 0.2-2.0.

unreadable_items: The two '0.8' labels on the solid-curve family cannot be unambiguously assigned to individual curves at the supplied resolution
No numeric stress-amplitude or cycle values are printed on the curves, so per-curve positions can only be estimated against the gridlines
